text:
maria: FYI — noticed a pending negative adjustment on the AWS channel invoice for reseller EdgeWave. Amount is $23,482 and it's showing as a credit on INV-2026-0421, but we don't have any approved refund on file. @ashok can you check what triggered it?

ashok: looking now. do we have the usage report or settlement id? could be a late usage rollback or a marketplace fee reversal. sending a quick query to marketplace API.

aws-marketplace-bot: Automated notice: Adjustment detected for account 'edgewave-reseller' on invoice INV-2026-0421. Adjustment ID: ADJ-98321. Type: Negative usage credit.

maria: ADJ-98321 — that matches. I pulled the CSV from the billing portal, snippet below (redacted):

```
invoice_id,account,sku,amount,reason
INV-2026-0421,edgewave-reseller,rdw-usage-embeddings,-23482.00,partner refund: misattributed seats
```

ashok: hmm misattributed seats — that looks like a channel partner mapping issue. EdgeWave submitted a claim citing duplicated seat mapping in our reseller integration. I need the original order IDs to validate. maria can you confirm whether we have the mapping logs for March-April sync?

maria: I have the sync logs for March 28 and April 2. quick grep shows two events where channel_id was mapped twice: `channel_sync:edgewave / order_map:dup` — attaching the raw lines in the ticket.

julie: tagging for approval flow: since this is > $20k it needs VP finance + partner ops signoff before we post any refund to customer-facing balance. what's our recommended path?

ashok: propose: 1) Confirm duplicate mapping and calculate net impact (done ~ $23.5k). 2) Ask EdgeWave to confirm acceptance of credit (they already opened a ticket). 3) Get VP finance (julie to escalate) to approve adjustment posting. 4) If approved, create GL adjustment and update AR ledger.

julie: I'll escalate to VP finance (cc: vp_finance). Maria — can you create a short one-pager with the timeline, evidence (sync logs + marketplace CSV), and the proposed accounting entry? Put it in the approvals thread with a clear approval checkbox.

maria: on it. ETA 2 hours. attaching the CSV + log excerpt to the JIRA ticket FIN-2489. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-2489

ashok: once we have the approval, I can run the adjustment through the marketplace reconciliation flow. note: we might need to mark this as "channel partner credit" in our billing system so the reseller doesn't get double-credited.

julie: noted. also please estimate downstream P&L impact for the month — we'll need that for monthly close. maria, add the P&L note to FIN-2489.

maria: will do. ping me if anyone needs a deeper extract. :thumbsup:

aws-marketplace-bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled in 48h for Adjustment ADJ-98321 to check status.
__notes: This document is a single Slack thread capturing a finance ops discussion about an AWS marketplace channel negative adjustment and the approval flow. Messages are in chronological order and written in realistic Slack style.
